title: Penerapan Prosedur Vouching Atas Transaksi Beban dalam Menilai Keandalan Bukti Digital
abstractText: The development of digital technology has shifted audit evidence from physical documents to digital documents submitted electronically. This transition facilitates document collection but creates challenges in assessing evidence reliability, particularly when documents are incomplete, unclear, or derived solely from clients’ internal sources. This study examines the implementation of vouching procedures for expense transactions to assess digital evidence reliability at KAP SSR. A descriptive qualitative method with a case study approach was employed. Data were collected through observations during internship activities, documentation of audit working papers and supporting expense transaction documents, and semi-structured interviews with junior and senior auditors. The findings indicate that vouching involves selecting expense transactions, requesting supporting documents, matching evidence with accounting records, and documenting examination results in audit working papers. Digital evidence reliability is assessed through document sources, information completeness, readability, authorization, consistency with accounting records, and support from external documents. The study concludes that vouching applies to both physical and digital evidence, while maintaining consideration of the sufficiency, appropriateness, and reliability of audit evidence in accordance with SA 500 principles.

title: Developing a new CT-based bone defect classification in revision knee arthroplasty
abstractText: Aims To seek consensus on the principles and criteria necessary to develop a CT-based bone defect classification (BDC) for revision knee arthroplasty. Methods A three-round structured Delphi study was conducted. First, five interviews were held with international knee revision experts to support the development of 29 statements. Two consecutive rounds of Delphi survey statements were distributed among 56 international knee revision experts in the first round, and to 37 in the second round. Consensus (≥ 80% agreement) was sought on the statements covering bone defect definitions, imaging, and zonal assessment. Results A total of 37 experts responded to the first survey round, and 34 also completed the second round. Consensus was reached on 93% of the statements after both survey rounds. Experts agreed that a BDC should guide both surgical planning and implant selection, and that CT imaging improves knee revision bone defect assessment. Consensus was also reached on the definition of a bone defect. While anatomical zones (epiphysis, metaphysis, diaphysis) were considered important for inclusion in a BDC, the results showed no consensus on which landmarks define these anatomical zones. Conclusion The expert panel indicated that CT evaluation and distinct assessment of anatomical zones are essential in a (new) BDC, although no consensus was reached on the definition of those anatomical zones. Moreover, a CT-based BDC should be useful for guiding surgical planning and implant selection. Cite this article: Bone Jt Open 2026;7(10):1272–1279.

title: PENGEMBANGAN e-LKPD BERBASIS CHEMO-ENTREPRENEURSHIP (CEP) PADA MATERI LAJU REAKSI BERORIENTASI PADA KREATIVITAS MURID
abstractText: This research is motivated by the lack of conceptual understanding and creativity in the reaction rate material caused by the abstract nature of the material so that it is necessary to use interesting and contextual teaching materials. This study aims to develop e-LKPD based on Chemo-Entrepreneurship (CEP) and to determine the feasibility, student responses oriented towards creativity in the developed product. The research method used is Research and Development (R&D) with the Lee & Owens development model with ADDIE stages (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). The product developed is an e-LKPD based on Chemo-Entrepreneurship (CEP) which contains text, images, videos, and practice questions in the form of e-LKPD and integrates 4 indicators of creativity. The trial subjects were students of grade XI Phase F2 of SMA Negeri 8 Muaro Jambi as respondents to one-on-one and small group trials. Data were collected through interviews, observations, and questionnaires. Furthermore, material validation obtained a percentage of 92% and media validation 92.4% with a very feasible category. The results of the study indicate that the developed e-LKPD is classified as very feasible with student responses in the one-on-one test of 95% and small group trials obtained a percentage of 96.4% with a very good category. Thus, it shows that the CEP-based e-LKPD is suitable for use as a supporting teaching material for learning reaction rates in high school and has the potential to improve the understanding of abstract concepts and develop student creativity. ABSTRAK Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh kurangnya kemampuan pemahaman konsep dan kreativitas pada materi laju reaksi yang disebabkan karena sifat materi yang bersifat abstrak sehingga diperlukan penggunaan bahan ajar yang menarik dan kontekstual. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan e-LKPD berbasis Chemo-Entrepreneurship (CEP) serta mengetahui kelayakan, respon siswa yang berorientasi pada kreativitas pada produk yang dikembangkan. Metode penelitian yang digunakan adalah Research and Development (R&D) dengan model pengembangan Lee & Owens dengan tahap ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). Produk yang dikembangkan berupa e-LKPD berbasis Chemo-Entrepreneurship (CEP) yang memuat berupa teks, gambar, video, dan soal Latihan dalam bentuk e-LKPD serta mengintegrasikan 4 indikator kreativitas. Subjek uji coba adalah Siswa kelas XI Fase F2 SMA Negeri 8 Muaro Jambi sebagai responden uji coba satu-satu dan kelompok kecil. Data dikumpulkan melalui wawancara, obsrvasi, dan angket. Selanjutnya Validasi materi diperoleh persentase 92% dan validasi Media 92,4% dengan kategori sangat layak. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa e-LKPD yang dikembangkan tergolong sangat layak dengan respon siswa pada uji satu satu sebesar sebesar 95% dan uji coba kelompok kecil memperoleh persentase 96,4% dengan kategori sangat baik. Dengan demikian menunjukkan bahwa e-LKPD berbasis CEP layak digunakan sebagai bahan ajar pendukung pembelajaran laju reaksi di SMA Serta berpotensi meningkatkan pemahaman konsep yang abstrak dan pengembangan kreativitas murid.

title: RSL24D1 links ribosome biogenesis to p53 activation in melanoma
abstractText: Abstract Melanoma cells exhibit elevated translation activity and rely on intact ribosomes to sustain their high protein synthesis demand. To support this process, efficient ribosome biogenesis is essential. RSL24D1 is a ribosome biogenesis factor required for late-stage maturation of the 60S ribosomal subunit. By ensuring correct ribosomal assembly, RSL24D1 supports global protein translation and maintains cellular homeostasis. Transcript and protein analyses revealed that RSL24D1 is upregulated in melanoma cells compared to normal human epidermal melanocytes. This overexpression correlates with reduced patient survival, suggesting an oncogenic role. Reduction of RSL24D1 expression impaired protein synthesis, decreased cell growth and resulted in the accumulation of unincorporated ribosomal proteins RPL5 and RPL11, which form the 5S RNP complex and inhibit the binding of MDM2 to p53. This inhibition stabilised p53 and activated downstream targets, including CDKN1A , resulting in G1 phase arrest and a senescence-like phenotype. These findings identify RSL24D1 as a critical component linking ribosome biogenesis to the p53 stress response. Targeting RSL24D1 creates a translational bottleneck, suppressing cell growth in p53 wild-type and p53-mutant cancer cells, highlighting it as a potential therapeutic target.

title: Valorization of petroleum coke into high-quality few-layer graphene through liquid-phase exfoliation
abstractText: Abstract Low-value fuel-grade petroleum coke (petcoke), an abundant byproduct from petroleum refining operations, is traditionally used in low-value fuel and metallurgical applications owing to its high carbon content and ability to be used in the synthesis of advanced carbon materials. In this paper, we demonstrate a non-oxidation-based route for producing conductive few-layer graphene from petcoke through sequential isopropanol assisted pre-treatment, thermal desulfurization, and CO 2 assisted liquid phase exfoliation. Unlike conventional graphene synthesis processes using high temperature chemical vapor deposition, oxidation reduction-based Hummer’s type methods, or exfoliation from expensive graphite sources, our approach enables the conversion of inexpensive petcoke into graphene nanosheets using a scalable solvent assisted route. Thermal treatment increased the graphitization degree of petroleum coke to approximately 78%, demonstrating its potential as a precursor for advanced graphitic materials. The optimized CO₂-assisted liquid-phase exfoliation and centrifugation procedure achieved approximately 90% recovery of dispersed exfoliated carbon solids. Combined optical microscopy, Raman, TEM, HRTEM, AFM, and electrical analyses confirmed the formation of well-dispersed, conductive few-layer graphene nanosheets, with thicknesses corresponding to approximately 3–5 layers. The graphene dispersions display stability up to six months and can be transformed into conductive films with a maximum electrical conductivity of 872 S m⁻ 1 after thermal annealing. This work establishes petcoke as a promising low-cost carbon resource for sustainable graphene production and offers a practical route for transforming refinery waste into value-added materials for energy storage, conductive coatings, composites, and carbon-based technologies.

Removal of carbofuran from aqueous solutions using activated carbon derived from Pistacia khinjuk stocks (bıttım) shell waste
abstractText: Abstract Pesticides are important environmental pollutants that require effective removal to protect ecosystems and human health. This study investigated carbofuran removal from water using KOH-activated carbon derived from Pistacia khinjuk Stocks (bıttım) shell waste. The resulting adsorbent exhibited a high specific surface area (1552 m² g⁻¹). Under the selected conditions (50 mg L⁻¹ carbofuran, 0.01 g adsorbent, 0.25 L solution, pH 4.0, 25 min, and 298 K), the highest experimental adsorption capacity was 324.3 mg g⁻¹. In synthetic water, the adsorption capacity was 276.5 mg g⁻¹, retaining approximately 85.3% of that obtained in ultrapure water. The apparent thermodynamic parameters and the decrease in adsorption capacity with increasing temperature were consistent with favorable adsorption and an exothermic temperature dependence under the investigated conditions. The Langmuir isotherm best described the equilibrium data. Adsorption appeared to involve hydrophobic and π–π electron donor–acceptor interactions, while electrostatic attraction likely played a limited role. These findings demonstrate the potential of bıttım shell-derived activated carbon as a biomass-derived adsorbent for carbofuran removal from water.

The reactivation of the Niscemi landslide (southern Italy) after the Cyclone Harry
abstractText: Abstract On January 25, 2026, a large compound slide affected the southern and western slopes of the Niscemi mesa (SE Sicily), causing severe damage to settlements and the evacuation of approximately 1500 people. The event occurred approximately one week after Cyclone Harry, which brought intense rainfall over southern Sicily, and represents the latest reactivation within a historically unstable slope system previously affected by major failures in 1790 and 1997. This study integrates geomorphological mapping, DInSAR and feature-tracking analysis, slope stability modelling, and meteorological data analysis to gain initial insights into the failure mechanisms, precursory and ongoing kinematics, and triggering conditions of the last reactivation of the Niscemi landslide. Results highlight a deep-seated compound mechanism controlled by weak layers and pre-existing slip surfaces within the clayey Mt. San Giorgio Formation. Pre-event interferometric data show limited accelerating deformation at the mesa edge, suggesting rapid failure onset. Numerical simulations suggest the key role of weak layers in governing large-scale instability. The findings emphasize the importance of combining geomorphological memory and satellite data for an improved hazard assessment of dormant landslides that frequently involve slopes of the Apennine Mountains of Italy.

abstractText: BACKGROUND The association between temporal encephaloceles (TEs) and drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) is well recognized, yet the literature regarding therapeutic management remains scarce and largely retrospective. Reported strategies vary from conservative approaches to extensive resection of encephaloceles including the adjacent epileptogenic zone (EZ). Surprisingly, although the EZ may be localized within or adjacent to eloquent areas, surgeries under awake conditions have not been described. One plausible explanation is the potential risk of intraoperative pain during surgical manipulation in the area of the richly innervated basal dura. OBSERVATIONS The authors present a case of a 23-year-old right-handed male with a left-sided TE associated with incapacitating DRE lasting 8 years. Preoperative evaluation, including 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography, suggested a large EZ within the dominant temporal lobe. An awake resection of the encephalocele and the EZ was performed; electrocorticography was utilized to tailor the resection extent. Speech and language functions were tested during the entire procedure. Surgical manipulation during encephalocele resection did not cause any discomfort. No postoperative neurological deficit was observed; the long-term seizure outcome is Engel class II. The patient returned to work. LESSONS In selected cases in which the EZ adjacent to TEs involves eloquent areas, awake resection may be safely performed. https://thejns.org/doi/10.3171/CASE26699

title: PENGARUH MODEL PEMBELAJARAN QUANTUM TEACHING TERHADAP HASIL BELAJAR SISWA PADA MATA PELAJARAN IPAS KELAS V
abstractText: Natural and Social Sciences (IPAS) learning in elementary schools requires contextual conceptual understanding; however, student achievement remains low due to passive instructional practices that fail to accommodate diverse learning styles. This study aimed to determine the effect of the quantum teaching learning model on the IPAS learning outcomes of fifth-grade students at SD Swasta Cenderamata in the 2025/2026 academic year. This research employed a quantitative approach with an experimental method using a pre-experimental one-group pretest-posttest design. The sampling technique was purposive sampling, selecting 28 students from class V-A as the research participants. Data were gathered through a 20-item multiple-choice cognitive achievement test with verified validity and reliability, supported by an instructional implementation questionnaire. The results demonstrated that the average pretest score increased from 62.57 to 84.00 in the posttest following the implementation of the quantum teaching model. The correlation coefficient analysis yielded an r_"count" of 0.834, which exceeded the r_"table" value of 0.388 at the 5% significance level. Furthermore, the hypothesis testing using the t-test revealed t_"count" =7.700, surpassing t_"table" =2.048 (p=0.000<0.05), thus confirming the acceptance of the alternative hypothesis (H_a). It can be concluded that the quantum teaching learning model exerts a positive and statistically significant effect on elementary school students' IPAS learning outcomes. ABSTRAK Pembelajaran Ilmu Pengetahuan Alam dan Sosial (IPAS) di sekolah dasar menuntut penguasaan konsep yang kontekstual, namun dalam praktiknya hasil belajar siswa masih tergolong rendah akibat pembelajaran yang cenderung pasif dan belum mengakomodasi keberagaman gaya belajar. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh model pembelajaran quantum teaching terhadap hasil belajar IPAS siswa kelas V SD Swasta Cenderamata Tahun Ajaran 2025/2026. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode eksperimen melalui desain pre-experimental jenis one-group pretest-posttest design. Teknik pengambilan sampel yang digunakan adalah purposive sampling, dengan memilih kelas V-A yang berjumlah 28 siswa sebagai subjek penelitian. Instrumen pengumpulan data berupa tes hasil belajar berbentuk pilihan ganda sebanyak 20 butir soal yang telah teruji validitas dan reliabilitasnya, serta didukung oleh angket keterlaksanaan pembelajaran. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan nilai rata-rata pretest sebelum perlakuan sebesar 62,57 meningkat menjadi 84,00 pada saat posttest setelah penerapan model quantum teaching. Pengujian koefisien korelasi menghasilkan nilai r_"hitung" sebesar 0,834 yang lebih besar dari r_"tabel" sebesar 0,388 pada taraf signifikansi 5%. Analisis uji hipotesis melalui uji-t menghasilkan nilai t_"hitung" sebesar 7,700 yang melampaui t_"tabel" sebesar 2,048 (p=0,000<0,05), sehingga hipotesis alternatif (H_a) diterima. Dengan demikian, disimpulkan bahwa penerapan model pembelajaran quantum teaching berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap peningkatan hasil belajar IPAS siswa sekolah dasar.

abstractText: The demonstration method has proven capable of providing a concrete and meaningful learning experience for students, making it a highly relevant alternative solution to address low academic achievement in elementary science. The low Natural and Social Sciences (IPAS) learning outcomes among fourth-grade students at SDN 009 Samarinda formed the empirical background of this study, marked by a pre-cycle average score of only 62.58 and a classical mastery rate of 25.81%. This study aims to describe the implementation of the demonstration method in improving IPAS learning outcomes on the topic of Force among fourth-grade students at SDN 009 Samarinda. This study employed Classroom Action Research (CAR) conducted across two cycles, comprising planning, acting, observing, and reflecting phases. The subjects were all 31 fourth-grade students at SDN 009 Samarinda in the 2025/2026 academic year. Data were gathered through participatory observation, cognitive achievement tests, and field notes. The findings indicate that the systematic application of the demonstration method significantly enhanced students' learning outcomes. In Cycle I, the class average score improved to 73.48 with a classical mastery rate of 51.61% (moderate category). Following instructional refinements in Cycle II by actively involving students in physical demonstrations, the class average rose to 82.26 with classical mastery reaching 96.77% (very high category), further substantiated by an N-gain score of 0.7281 (high category). Thus, the demonstration method is empirically proven to be effective in augmenting primary students' IPAS learning outcomes. ABSTRAK Metode demonstrasi terbukti mampu menghadirkan pengalaman belajar yang konkret dan bermakna bagi peserta didik, sehingga menjadi salah satu alternatif solusi yang relevan untuk mengatasi rendahnya hasil belajar Ilmu Pengetahuan Alam dan Sosial (IPAS) di sekolah dasar. Rendahnya hasil belajar IPAS pada siswa kelas IV SDN 009 Samarinda menjadi latar belakang dilaksanakannya penelitian ini, di mana nilai rata-rata pra-siklus hanya mencapai 62,58 dengan persentase ketuntasan klasikal sebesar 25,81%. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan penerapan metode demonstrasi dalam meningkatkan hasil belajar IPAS pada materi Gaya siswa kelas IV SDN 009 Samarinda. Jenis penelitian yang digunakan adalah Penelitian Tindakan Kelas (PTK) yang dirancang dalam dua siklus tindakan, di mana setiap siklus mencakup tahap perencanaan, pelaksanaan, observasi, dan refleksi. Subjek penelitian adalah seluruh siswa kelas IV SDN 009 Samarinda tahun ajaran 2025/2026 yang berjumlah 31 siswa. Teknik pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi aktivitas, tes evaluasi hasil belajar, dan catatan lapangan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penerapan metode demonstrasi secara konsisten meningkatkan hasil belajar IPAS secara signifikan. Pada siklus I, nilai rata-rata siswa meningkat menjadi 73,48 dengan ketuntasan klasikal 51,61% (kategori sedang). Setelah dilakukan perbaikan pada siklus II dengan melibatkan partisipasi langsung siswa, nilai rata-rata meningkat kembali menjadi 82,26 dengan ketuntasan klasikal mencapai 96,77% (kategori sangat tinggi), serta diperkuat oleh capaian N-gain sebesar 0,7281 (kategori tinggi). Dengan demikian, penerapan metode demonstrasi terbukti efektif dalam meningkatkan hasil belajar IPAS materi Gaya pada siswa sekolah dasar.

abstractText: BACKGROUND Hemifacial spasm (HFS) results from pulsatile neurovascular conflict at the facial nerve root exit zone (REZ) and is treated with microvascular decompression (MVD). Aneurysm-related HFS is rare, and evidence for flow diversion (FD) is limited. OBSERVATIONS Two women with vertebral artery (VA) fusiform/dissecting aneurysms presented with ipsilateral HFS and underwent flow diverter treatment. Case 1 had bilateral fusiform VA aneurysms; the symptomatic left V4 lesion compressed the REZ without branch incorporation. Overlapping Pipeline Shield devices achieved complete occlusion and durable HFS resolution. Case 2 had a left V4 dissecting aneurysm incorporating the posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA). A FRED flow diverter reduced aneurysmal filling and transiently improved HFS, but residual filling persisted mainly around the PICA origin and symptoms recurred. Nineteen months later, lateral suboccipital MVD transposed the VA-PICA complex away from the REZ with sustained control. LESSONS FD can cure aneurysm-related HFS without craniotomy when complete exclusion is feasible and no critical branch is incorporated. In branch-bearing lesions, incomplete occlusion and persistent contact may cause recurrence; structured follow-up and readiness for staged MVD are essential. abstractText: Proses transisi akademis dari pendidikan menengah menuju perguruan tinggi kerap menyajikan hambatan penyesuaian bagi mahasiswa tahun pertama, khususnya pada mata kuliah fondasi seperti Pengantar Manajemen. Melalui kebijakan Merdeka Belajar Kampus Merdeka (MBKM), Program Praktisi Mengajar dihadirkan untuk menjembatani teori akademis dengan realitas dunia kerja. Penelitian kuantitatif deskriptif berpendekatan survei evaluatif ini bertujuan menganalisis persepsi dan tingkat kepuasan mahasiswa baru terhadap skema pengajaran oleh dosen praktisi. Data dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner Skala Likert 5 tingkat pada sampel N = 85 mahasiswa semester awal Program Studi Bisnis Digital Universitas Negeri Jakarta. Evaluasi mencakup empat dimensi utama: kejelasan penyampaian, relevansi studi kasus, interaktivitas kelas, serta dampak terhadap pemahaman dan motivasi belajar. Hasil analisis deskriptif menunjukkan tingkat kepuasan secara keseluruhan berada pada kategori Sangat Tinggi dengan nilai rerata (Mean) 4,52 dari skala 5,00 (capaian 90,4%). Dimensi Relevansi Studi Kasus mencatatkan skor tertinggi (Mean = 4,68), diikuti oleh Dampak Pemahaman dan Motivasi (Mean = 4,60). Temuan ini mengonfirmasi bahwa keterlibatan profesional industri secara signifikan memperkuat pemahaman kontekstual, mengurangi beban kognitif, dan mempercepat adaptasi akademis mahasiswa baru. Penelitian ini memberikan batasan pedagogis serta saran praktis bagi pengelola program studi dalam merancang panduan instruksional kolaboratif.

title: Sn/Zr Mixed-Metal Clusters in MOFs as Lewis Acid Catalysts for Biomass-Derived HMF Synthesis
abstractText: Abstract The depletion of fossil fuels has spurred the search for sustainable routes to platform chemicals, yet the efficient conversion of biomass-derived fructose to 5-(hydroxymethyl)furfural (HMF) remains challenging. While Sn-based Lewis acids are promising catalysts for this dehydration reaction, conventional homogeneous systems suffer from separation and corrosion issues, and heterogeneous supports often fail to stabilize isolated Sn atoms, leading to aggregation into less selective Sn dimers or clusters. Herein, we report a strategy to construct single-atom Sn catalytic sites within a metal–organic framework (MOF). By post-synthetic metalation of the open Zr6 nodes in PCN-224(Co), Sn4+ ions are precisely anchored to form well-defined Sn/Zr mixed-metal clusters without disrupting the parent framework topology. The resulting Sn-PCN-224(Co) catalyst achieves 100% fructose conversion and 72% HMF yield under mild conditions─a dramatic enhancement over the unmodified MOF, which produces negligible HMF. The dispersed Sn centers, spatially isolated by the periodic MOF nodes, effectively suppress deleterious Sn–Sn interactions and stabilize key reaction intermediates, as elucidated by density functional theory (DFT) calculations. This strategy proves general across diverse Zr-MOF platforms (PCN-222, MOF-808, NU-1000), and the catalyst exhibits excellent recyclability. This work demonstrates how precision chemistry in MOFs can address the fundamental challenge of single-atom catalyst stability, offering a robust platform for biomass conversion and sustainable chemical synthesis.

title: Stacking ensemble learning and SHAP analysis for predicting CO2 solubility and guiding ionic liquid design
abstractText: Abstract Excessive CO2 emissions constitute a primary driver of global climate change, creating an urgent need for efficient CO2 capture technologies. Ionic liquids (ILs) are considered highly promising absorbents. However, their vast chemical space poses significant challenges for experimental screening. In this study, Morgan fingerprint descriptors were combined with a stacking ensemble learning algorithm, and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis was employed to develop an accurate and interpretable framework for predicting CO2 solubility. The stacking ensemble model employs the light gradient boosting machine and the backpropagation neural network as base learners. The dung beetle optimizer and the grey wolf optimizer were used to determine optimal hyperparameter combinations for these learners, while linear regression was adopted as the meta-learner to produce the final CO2 solubility prediction. The results demonstrate that the stacking ensemble algorithm achieves the highest predictive accuracy, attaining a test-set coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.9888, a mean absolute error of 0.0149 and a mean squared error of 0.0006. SHAP analysis further reveals that the [Tf2N] (bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)amide) anion exerts the most significant influence, followed by the alkyl chain length of imidazolium cations. Accordingly, combining the [Tf2N] anion with imidazolium cations bearing longer alkyl chains represents a promising strategy for synthesizing ILs with high CO2 absorption efficiency.

title: PENGEMBANGAN MODUL AJAR IPAS BERBASIS PBL-STEM PADA MATERI ORGAN PERNAPASAN MANUSIA UNTUK SISWA KELAS V SD
abstractText: This research is motivated by the gap between the demands of the Independent Curriculum which emphasizes innovative learning and the availability of PBL-STEM-based teaching tools at SDN 021 Sungai Kunjang. Learning conditions that are still dominated by conventional methods (teacher-centered) have an impact on the lack of active student participation, so it is necessary to develop teaching modules that are able to trigger critical power and integration between disciplines. This study aims to describe the process of developing the science teaching module on human respiratory organ materials and to determine the feasibility level of the product produced. The method used is Research and Development (R&D) by adapting the 4D (Define, Design, Develop, Disseminate) model from Thiagarajan (1974), which in its implementation is limited to the develop stage. The limited trial was carried out on 23 students of class V A. Data collection instruments included expert validation sheets, observation sheets on learning implementation, and student response questionnaires. The results of the study showed a very high level of feasibility, evidenced by the average percentage of validation of subject matter experts of 93.5%, linguists of 91%, and media experts of 90%. In addition, the results of observation of learning implementation reached an average of 94% with the very good category, and the student response questionnaire obtained a score of 83.41% with the very good category. Thus, the PBL-STEM-based science teaching module on human respiratory organ material is declared valid and practical to be used in learning in grade V of elementary school, and is effective as a solution to the need for innovative and contextual teaching tools. ABSTRAK Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh adanya kesenjangan antara tuntutan Kurikulum Merdeka yang menekankan pembelajaran inovatif dengan ketersediaan perangkat ajar berbasis PBL-STEM di SDN 021 Sungai Kunjang. Kondisi pembelajaran yang masih didominasi metode konvensional (teacher-centered) berdampak pada minimnya partisipasi aktif siswa, sehingga diperlukan pengembangan modul ajar yang mampu memicu daya kritis dan integrasi antar disiplin ilmu. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan proses pengembangan modul ajar IPAS pada materi organ pernapasan manusia serta mengetahui tingkat kelayakan produk yang dihasilkan. Metode yang digunakan adalah Research and Development (R&D) dengan mengadaptasi model 4D (Define, Design, Develop, Disseminate) dari Thiagarajan (1974), yang dalam pelaksanaannya dibatasi hingga tahap Develop. Uji coba terbatas dilakukan pada 23 siswa kelas V A. Instrumen pengumpulan data meliputi lembar validasi ahli, lembar observasi keterlaksanaan pembelajaran, dan angket respon siswa. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan tingkat kelayakan yang sangat tinggi, dibuktikan dengan rata-rata persentase validasi ahli materi sebesar 93,5%, ahli bahasa 91%, dan ahli media 90%. Selain itu, hasil observasi keterlaksanaan pembelajaran mencapai rata-rata 94% dengan kategori sangat baik, serta angket respon siswa memperoleh skor 83,41% dengan kategori sangat baik. Dengan demikian, modul ajar IPAS berbasis PBL-STEM pada materi organ pernapasan manusia dinyatakan valid dan praktis digunakan dalam pembelajaran di kelas V SD, serta efektif menjadi solusi atas kebutuhan perangkat ajar yang inovatif dan kontekstual.

title: Cognitive and Affective Dimensions of Marketing Translation and Localization
abstractText: Marketing localization requires decisions about meaning, tone, cultural references, and the relationship between language and visual presentation. However, claims that creative translation necessarily produces trust or purchasing behavior frequently exceed the evidence available. This article develops a conceptual framework for examining the cognitive and affective dimensions of marketing translation while distinguishing textual adaptation from demonstrated audience effects. A focused narrative synthesis brings together twenty-one publications from 2020–2025 in translation studies, consumer research, international marketing, and translation technology. The analysis separates five dimensions: claim integrity, processing and comprehension, affective and social interpretation, multimodal coherence, and outcome evaluation. It argues that effective localization cannot be reduced either to literal correspondence or to unrestricted creative rewriting. Instead, the appropriate degree of adaptation depends on the communicative purpose, audience, medium, and factual commitments of the message. Hypothetical examples illustrate how alternative formulations can be evaluated without treating preferred wording as proof of persuasion. The resulting framework connects translation decisions with explicit hypotheses and appropriate forms of evidence. Its contribution is a transparent procedure for designing and evaluating localized communication; it does not establish causal effects on consumers. The article concludes with implications for professional practice, translator education, and future reception research.

title: Epidemiology of Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei (EHP) in East Java: Spatiotemporal Distribution and Risk Factors in Shrimp Aquaculture
abstractText: Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei (EHP) remains a persistent challenge in shrimp aquaculture because it severely reduces growth rates. This study investigated the spatio-temporal dynamics of EHP infection in East Java, Indonesia, and identified key risk factors relevant to local production systems. Over one year, 990 samples were collected, comprising 523 from shrimp and 467 from pond water, across five major regions: Banyuwangi, Jember, Madura, Probolinggo, and Situbondo. Statistical analyses commenced with Chi-square tests to assess associations, followed by multivariate logistic regression to identify significant predictors of infection. The overall EHP prevalence was 27.07%, with substantial variation by sample type and region. Infection rates were significantly higher in shrimp (40.54%) than in water samples (11.99%), and Banyuwangi exhibited the highest prevalence at 32.50%. The regression model demonstrated that water samples were significantly less likely to test positive than shrimp, and that Jember, Madura, and Situbondo had lower odds of infection compared to Banyuwangi. Seasonal trends were evident, with July representing a period of elevated risk and September a period of reduced transmission. These findings indicate that biological, spatial, and seasonal factors influence EHP infection dynamics in East Java. Targeted monitoring of shrimp tissues in high-risk regions such as Banyuwangi during mid-year months is recommended for effective disease management.

title: Cranial anatomy of the Middle Eocene Egyptian crocodylian Herugavialis cairensis provides new insights into gavialoid diversity in the Mediterranean region
abstractText: Abstract Gavialoidea is presently composed of only two extant crocodylian species, the Indian gharial Gavialis gangeticus, and the false gharial Tomistoma schlegelii, both from southeast Asia. However, Gavialoidea displays a rich and near-cosmopolitan diversity in the fossil record, with over 40 species currently recognized. Several of these gavialoids are recovered from Cenozoic deposits in the Mediterranean region, with many assigned historically to the genus Tomistoma. However, recent phylogenetic analyses do not typically recover these species as closely related to the false gharial, with several fossil species in need of taxonomic revision. Here, we present a detailed re-evaluation of one of these species, Tomistoma cairense from the Middle Eocene Mokattam Formation of Egypt, based on the holotype skull and several referred specimens. Supplemented by endocranial anatomy revealed via computed tomography (CT), we identify numerous anatomical differences with T. schlegelii and other gavialoids, including the approximately contemporaneous Egyptian species, Eogavialis africanum and Paratomistoma courti. These differences are reinforced through phylogenetic analysis under maximum parsimony, in which T. cairense is recovered as a gavialoid that does not cluster with T. schlegelii or Mediterranean taxa. We erect a new genus name for T. cairense, with the resultant new combination of Herugavialis cairensis diagnosed by several characteristics, including telescoped orbits. An apparent decline in Mediterranean gavialoid diversity during the Late Eocene–Oligocene is potentially driven by a reduction in habitat, as a result of global cooling and declining eustatic sea level. Warming in the Miocene might have facilitated a subsequent rebound in gavialoid diversity, prior to the extirpation of crocodylians in the Mediterranean region in the Late Miocene, which might have been caused by the Messinian Salinity Crisis. The taxonomic revision of additional Mediterranean gavialoid species should facilitate greater insight into their evolutionary history and demise.

title: Memory on ice: spatial memory is retained over a 9-month hibernation period in Columbian ground squirrels
abstractText: Abstract Memory allows animals to utilize ecologically relevant information, yet whether it endures through prolonged metabolic shutdown is poorly understood. We tested spatial memory retention in a long-term, free-living hibernator, the Columbian ground squirrel (Urocitellus columbianus), using a field-based spatial maze over two consecutive active seasons. Ten individuals were tested before and after a 9-month hibernation period and compared with eight naive individuals. Maze-solving performances—time to exit, path sinuosity and navigational errors—were analysed over 10 consecutive trials using Bayesian nonlinear learning curves to separate retained memory from relearning. Strikingly, post-hibernation individuals with prior exposure to the task significantly outperformed naive individuals by 41–98% across all metrics, with initial performance after hibernation approaching pre-hibernation asymptotes. We show that spatial memory survives prolonged hibernation in the wild, supporting the hypothesis that neural plasticity during hibernation reflects adaptive retention rather than memory loss.

abstractText: Penelitian ini mengkaji peran mediasi kepercayaan merek dalam pengaruh pemasaran media sosial (SMM) dan siaran langsung (live streaming) TikTok terhadap keputusan memilih agen penempatan resmi pekerja migran Indonesia. Menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif eksplanatori, data dikumpulkan dari 97 pendaftar resmi yang dipilih secara purposif dari populasi 128 orang. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan metode Structural Equation Modeling-Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS) melalui perangkat lunak SmartPLS. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa SMM dan siaran langsung TikTok berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap kepercayaan merek (koefisien jalur=0,522; t-statistics=9,196; p-value=0,000; dan koefisien jalur=0,425; t-statistics=6,795; p-value=0,000) serta keputusan pemilihan (koefisien jalur=0,427; t-statistics=6,271; p-value=0,000; dan koefisien jalur=0,280; t-statistics=3,748; p-value=0,000). Selain itu, kepercayaan merek secara langsung memengaruhi keputusan pemilihan (koefisien jalur=0,277; t-statistics=2,944; p-value=0,003). Pengujian mediasi membuktikan bahwa kepercayaan merek secara signifikan memediasi secara parsial (partially-mediated) efek SMM (koefisien jalur=0,145; p-value=0,007) maupun siaran langsung TikTok (koefisien jalur=0,118; p-value=0,006) terhadap keputusan akhir tersebut. Secara praktis, agen penempatan perlu memprioritaskan transparansi biaya operasional dan menstandarisasi protokol siaran langsung guna meminimalkan asimetri informasi dan mendorong komitmen pendaftaran.

title: PENGARUH MODEL PEMBELAJARAN KOLABORATIF BERBANTUAN MEDIA KAHOOT TERHADAP HASIL BELAJAR IPAS SISWA
abstractText: This study was motivated by the low learning outcomes in Natural and Social Sciences (IPAS) among fourth-grade students at SD Negeri 173307 Sipultak, which were presumed to be influenced by teacher-centered instruction and the limited use of varied learning models and interactive instructional media. This study aimed to determine students' learning outcomes before the implementation of the collaborative learning model assisted by Kahoot, to examine its effect on IPAS learning outcomes, and to measure the magnitude of its influence. This research employed a quantitative approach using a One Group Pretest-Posttest Design. The research sample consisted of 30 fourth-grade students. Data were collected through tests, questionnaires, and documentation studies. The research instruments were tested for validity and reliability, while data analysis was conducted using the normality test, correlation coefficient test, coefficient of determination, and hypothesis testing (t-test). The findings revealed that the mean pretest score of 52.66 increased to 77.97 in the posttest, while the average questionnaire score reached 84.63, indicating that students' responses were categorized as very good. The results of the normality test indicated that the data were normally distributed, thereby meeting the assumptions for parametric statistical analysis. Furthermore, the correlation analysis showed a positive relationship between the implementation of the collaborative learning model assisted by Kahoot and students' learning outcomes. The hypothesis test also confirmed that the collaborative learning model assisted by Kahoot had a statistically significant effect on the IPAS learning outcomes of fourth-grade students at SD Negeri 173307 Sipultak in the 2025/2026 academic year. Therefore, the collaborative learning model assisted by Kahoot is effective in improving elementary school students' IPAS learning outcomes. ABSTRAK Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh rendahnya hasil belajar IPAS siswa kelas IV SD Negeri 173307 Sipultak yang diduga dipengaruhi oleh pembelajaran yang masih berpusat pada guru dan belum memanfaatkan model pembelajaran yang bervariasi serta media pembelajaran interaktif. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui hasil belajar siswa sebelum penerapan model pembelajaran kolaboratif berbantuan media Kahoot, mengetahui pengaruh penerapannya terhadap hasil belajar IPAS, serta mengetahui besarnya pengaruh yang diberikan. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kuantitatif dengan desain One Group Pretest-Posttest Design. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 30 siswa kelas IV. Teknik pengumpulan data meliputi tes, angket, dan studi dokumentasi. Instrumen penelitian telah memenuhi uji validitas dan reliabilitas, sedangkan analisis data dilakukan melalui uji normalitas, uji koefisien korelasi, koefisien determinasi, dan uji hipotesis (t). Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa rata-rata nilai pretest sebesar 52,66 meningkat menjadi 77,97 pada posttest, sedangkan rata-rata skor angket mencapai 84,63 yang menunjukkan respons siswa berada pada kategori sangat baik. Hasil uji normalitas menunjukkan data berdistribusi normal, sehingga memenuhi syarat untuk analisis parametrik. Selanjutnya, hasil uji korelasi menunjukkan adanya hubungan positif antara penerapan model pembelajaran kolaboratif berbantuan media Kahoot dengan hasil belajar siswa, sedangkan uji hipotesis membuktikan bahwa terdapat pengaruh yang signifikan terhadap hasil belajar IPAS siswa kelas IV SD Negeri 173307 Sipultak Tahun Ajaran 2025/2026. Dengan demikian, model pembelajaran kolaboratif berbantuan media Kahoot! efektif digunakan untuk meningkatkan hasil belajar IPAS siswa sekolah dasar.

abstractText: This study aims to analyze the dynamics of parenting styles and disciplinary behavior among children aged 5–6 years at TK Cinta Ibu, Purwakarta, focusing on how parenting styles are applied, the forms of disciplinary behavior that emerge, and the supporting and inhibiting factors involved. A qualitative case study approach was employed, involving 10 children aged 5–6 years and their parents as research subjects. Data were collected through questionnaires distributed to parents, observations of children's behavior at school, and documentation of activities. The data were then analyzed using the interactive model of Miles, Huberman, and Saldaña, supported by source triangulation. The findings indicate that most parents adopt a democratic parenting style, as reflected in the practice of explaining the reasons behind rules, maintaining open communication, providing supervision, and consistently implementing rules. Nevertheless, parents' positive perceptions do not fully correspond to the conditions observed at school, as children still frequently require guidance and repeated reminders during activities, such as putting away toys and waiting their turn in line. Variations in discipline levels among children were also identified, which cannot be entirely explained by parenting styles in general. Overall, democratic parenting serves as an important foundation for developing early childhood discipline; however, its implementation still requires consistent habituation both at home and at school, along with close collaboration between parents and teachers to align children's disciplinary habits across both environments.

title: Conformality in Hawksmoor's ceiling, the Roman Pantheon and Mercator's projection
abstractText: Abstract The dome of the Roman Pantheon is coffered with ribs surrounding sunken lacunaria, thus forming a grid. How this is achieved given the curvature of the dome has long been a subject for study and speculation. Although detailed measurements now exist, thus far no single principle has emerged which fixes the overall geometry. Similar coffering occurs in Hawksmoor's design for the ceiling of the Buttery in All Souls College, Oxford. Both these examples are doubly curved, making their tiling with (almost) square coffers problematic. We address this using methods of differential geometry. Observing that the ribs intersect orthogonally, we hypothesize that they are images under a conformal (angle preserving) mapping of a uniform M×N tiling of a planar rectangle with squares. This is unique and is the inverse of Mercator's projection of the ceiling to the rectangle. It minimizes an energy functional which captures the sum of the elastic and gravitational energies in the long wavelength limit. Thus, any construction method which is stable to long wavelength deformations necessarily leads to a conformal coffering. This then gives quantitative predictions with no adjustable parameters for the relative sizes and locations of each coffer, which are in good agreement with photographic data, and consistent with direct measurements of the Pantheon.

title: Transformation of the Social System for Teaching Arabic Writing in Islamic Boarding Schools
abstractText: This study aims to analyze the transformation of the social system of Kitābah (Arabic Writing) learning at an Arabic-specialized Islamic boarding school, covering teacher authority, patterns of interaction, student roles and participation, and academic collaboration in line with the development of students’ competences. The research employs a qualitative approach using a case study design at the Darun Nuhat Islamic Boarding School in Lamongan, which is a boarding school specializing in Nahwu-Sharaf that implements tiered learning through the Mubtadi’, ‘Alim, and ‘Allamah levels. One of the boarding school’s flagship programs is the writing of a risālah ‘ilmiyyah as an academic achievement at the ‘Allamah level. Data were collected through interviews, observations, and documentation from the boarding school’s management, Kitābah teachers, and students at each level of study. The data were analyzed through data reduction, data presentation, and drawing conclusions, and verified through triangulation. The research findings indicate that the transformation of the social system occurs gradually. Teachers’ authority shifted from a dominant role at the ‘Mubtadi’ level to a facilitative role at the ‘Alim level, and finally to academic supervision at the ‘Allamah level. Interaction patterns evolved from one-way to two-way and multi-directional collaborative interactions. The teacher’s role shifts from that of an instructor to a facilitator and supervisor, whilst student participation evolves from compliance with instructions towards collaboration and academic independence. Meanwhile, academic collaboration has not yet taken shape at the Mubtadi’ level and is becoming increasingly.

title: Thoracic and retroperitoneal lymphatic injuries following spine surgery: illustrative cases
abstractText: BACKGROUND Postoperative lymphatic leakage is a rare complication of spine surgery caused by injury to the thoracic duct, cisterna chyli, or retroperitoneal lymphatic channels. Because of its rarity, diagnosis is often delayed and optimal management remains poorly defined. The authors present 3 illustrative cases and review current diagnostic and therapeutic strategies. OBSERVATIONS A 66-year-old man developed a right chylothorax after posterior T2–3 corpectomy with costotransversectomy and cervicothoracic fusion for metastatic spinal cord compression. Following failed thoracic duct embolization, he underwent thoracoscopic ligation and talc pleurodesis with complete resolution. A 75-year-old man developed a retroperitoneal lymphatic leak after an aborted oblique lumbar interbody fusion (OLIF), which resolved with percutaneous drainage and dietary modification. A 70-year-old woman developed a symptomatic retroperitoneal lymphatic leak after staged multilevel OLIF and posterior deformity correction. Intranodal lymphangiography localized the leak and enabled successful embolization with n -butyl cyanoacrylate, avoiding reoperation. LESSONS Lymphatic injury after spine surgery is uncommon but may occur after both thoracic and retroperitoneal approaches. Early recognition, biochemical confirmation, and multidisciplinary management are essential. Lymphangiography is central to diagnosis and treatment, although refractory cases may require surgery. Awareness of these complications may improve patient outcomes. https://thejns.org/doi/10.3171/CASE26792

title: Experimental multi-level calibration of a silicon mini solar cell for low-cost solar irradiance measurement
abstractText: Abstract Accurate assessment of photovoltaic potential is essential for optimizing system integration at specific sites, requiring precise measurement of ground-level solar irradiance. However, commercially available irradiance sensors are often costly, limited in configurability for research, and require specialized calibration tools. To address these challenges, this study presents the design and development of a portable, energy-efficient, cost-effective irradiance measurement system. The device employs a small polycrystalline solar cell as the sensing element and a 10-bit microcontroller for data acquisition. Irradiance values are calculated using an established algebraic relationship between the solar cell’s short-circuit current and incident solar radiation. The sensor was then evaluated outdoors under clear-sky and partly cloudy conditions using a commercial handheld irradiance meter for comparison. Within the investigated dataset, the developed sensor showed a linear response across the tested irradiance range. The mean percentage deviation was 0.84% under clear-sky conditions and 3.11% under partly cloudy conditions, with maximum deviations of 15.5 W/m² at 491 W/m² and 12.5 W/m² at 130 W/m², respectively. These results indicate that, within the tested irradiance range and experimental conditions, the proposed low-cost system can provide consistent irradiance measurements suitable for experimental monitoring and preliminary PV site assessment.

title: Targeting GGT1 via RGD-modified lipid nanoparticles suppresses breast cancer lung metastasis by disrupting exosome-mediated angiogenesis
Stimulus Kognitif dan Motorik Lansia melalui Terapi Aktivitas Kelompok Memori Warna dan Transfer Bola
abstractText: The aging process in the elderly often leads to a decline in physiological functions, including reduced motor activity, impaired sensory function, and diminished cognitive abilities such as memory and concentration. This study aimed to evaluate the implementation of Group Activity Therapy (GAT) "Eling lan Obah," which combines color memory games and ball transfer activities using plastic cups, to stimulate cognitive and motor functions among elderly residents at Wisma Sapto Pratolo, BPSTW. A quasi-experimental approach with pre-test and post-test evaluations was utilized involving six elderly participants who met specific inclusion criteria. The color memory game was designed to train recall and concentration, whereas the ball transfer game focused on eye-hand coordination and fine motor skills. The results indicated noticeable improvements in concentration, recall speed, and hand-eye coordination among the majority of participants post-intervention. Furthermore, the group dynamic fostered increased social interaction, confidence, and active participation while reducing boredom. In conclusion, GAT "Eling lan Obah" serves as an effective non-pharmacological nursing intervention to maintain and enhance cognitive and motor functions in the elderly within institutional care settings.

title: Built for bulk: posture, microanatomy and soft tissue shaped gigantism in Sauropoda
abstractText: Abstract Sauropodomorph dinosaurs show how appendicular skeletal architecture accommodated extreme increases in body mass. Although sauropod gigantism has been linked to columnar limbs, wide-gauge posture, thick articular cartilage and tubular long-bone organization, the biomechanical interaction among these components is poorly understood. Here, we examine how femo ral shape, internal bone architecture and articular soft tissues influenced mechanical scaling across Sauropodomorpha. We generated three-dimensional femoral models spanning early sauropodomorphs, narrow-gauge diplodocoids, intermediate-gauge titanosauriforms, wide-gauge titanosaurs and an African elephant control. Finite element analyses compared theoretical solid models with taxon-specific native configurations, incorporating medullary cavities and articular cartilage caps. Mechanical performance was assessed using 95th-percentile von Mises stress, strain energy density and structural stiffness. Femoral performance did not scale uniformly with body mass. The two sampled narrow-gauge taxa, Diplodocus and Amargasaurus, defined steeper scaling trajectories for stress and strain energy density, whereas wide-gauge titanosaurs generally displayed flatter trajectories, comparatively lower stress and strain energy density, and elevated stiffness in several large-bodied forms. Targeted sensitivity analyses further showed that the mechanical effects of medullary architecture and cartilage depended on their interaction with taxon-specific femoral geometry. These findings suggest that sauropod gigantism was sustained by lineage-specific combinations of femoral geometry, internal architecture and articular soft tissues.

abstractText: This article develops a technology for organising the professional and methodological training of pre-service English language teachers through adaptive edutainment. The study aims to substantiate a technological solution that integrates diagnostic evidence, professional teaching situations, and game-informed learning activity within a single didactic cycle. The conceptual design study employed content analysis of scholarly sources, comparative analysis, pedagogical modelling, andfunctional decomposition.

title: Hemorrhagic lumbar synovial cyst mimicking a neoplastic process: illustrative case
abstractText: BACKGROUND Synovial cysts with extensive hemorrhage, marked mass effect, and tumor-like appearance are rare and may mimic neoplastic processes. OBSERVATIONS A 56-year-old man presented with progressive mechanical low back pain, neurogenic claudication, gait instability, and bilateral weakness. MRI revealed a 2.0-cm lesion arising from the right L3 facet joint, causing severe central canal and right foraminal stenosis with displacement of the cauda equina. Imaging features suggested pigmented villonodular synovitis. Intraoperatively, however, the lesion appeared fleshy, partially encapsulated, and dural adherent, resembling a nerve sheath tumor, with necrotic regions suggesting malignancy. Frozen-section analysis demonstrated benign fibroconnective tissue with marked reactive and degenerative changes, including necrosis and hemosiderin deposition, without evidence of neoplasia. Intraoperative confirmation of benign pathology shifted operative priorities toward anatomical preservation rather than extent of resection; gross-total removal was nevertheless achieved and the patient had complete neurological recovery. Permanent pathology was most consistent with a degenerative synovial cyst with hemorrhage. LESSONS This case highlights the importance of integrating imaging findings, intraoperative appearance, and histopathological evaluation rather than relying on a single diagnostic modality. The combination of a focused differential and confirmation of benign pathology guided the extent of resection, balancing maximal lesion removal with preservation of adjacent structural elements. https://thejns.org/doi/10.3171/CASE26317

title: Acute Whole-Body Heat Exposure Modulates EEG Microstate Dynamics, Phase-Lagged Connectivity, and Cortical Source Activity
abstractText: Abstract Acute exposure to elevated ambient temperature affects physiological regulation, thermal perception, and cognitive functioning, yet its influence on the spatiotemporal organization of human brain activity remains insufficiently understood. This study investigated temperature-related changes in EEG spectral power, microstates, functional connectivity, and cortical source activity. Fifteen healthy male participants completed three randomized 45-min seated exposures at ambient temperatures of 21, 30, and 38 °C while wearing standardized winter protective clothing (3.2 clo). EEG, skin temperature, core body temperature, and subjective thermal sensation were recorded. Mean skin temperature, core body temperature, and thermal-sensation votes increased with temperature and exposure duration. Global delta-band connectivity differed significantly across temperatures (χ 2 =12.64, FDR-adjusted q=0.0090). Delta connectivity was significantly higher at 38 °C than at 21 °C. Microstate D coverage differed across temperatures, with values of 0.145, 0.178, and 0.150 at 21, 30, and 38 °C, respectively (χ 2 =12.88, FDR-adjusted q=0.0064, W=0.429). Source-space analysis further demonstrated increased relative delta source power with temperature and reduced beta and gamma source power at 38 °C, particularly in occipital, parietal, sensorimotor, and posterior cingulate regions. Increasing ambient temperature was associated with a shift in EEG spectral activity toward lower frequencies, enhanced delta-band functional synchronization, and altered microstate temporal organization. Together, these exploratory findings indicate that spectral power, regional phase-lagged connectivity, and microstate dynamics show distinct responses to ambient temperature in healthy young men wearing protective clothing.

Evaluación de las propiedades del suelo bajo prácticas de agricultura climáticamente inteligente
abstractText: Soil is an essential and strategic resource for the sustainability of agricultural production on the planet; however, it faces progressive degradation derived from unsustainable management practices and the effects of climate change. Within this context, climate-smart agriculture emerges as an approach to try to increase productivity by strengthening the resilience of agricultural systems. The research aimed to evaluate the physical and chemical properties of the soil at two sites: 1) where an agropastoral system has been implemented as a CSA practice; and 2) where unsustainable agricultural techniques have been maintained. Soil sampling followed NOM-021-SEMARNAT-2000, dividing the soil into six 25 m2 plots, from which characteristics such as soil texture, structure, pH, real and bulk density, porosity, organic matter, total carbonates, and hydraulic conductivity were determined. It was concluded that implementing climate-smart agriculture practices through agropastoral systems improves soil physical properties early, with increases of 1% in organic matter and 1.64% in new pore space; by contrast, changes in chemical properties require longer time scales. These results highlight the potential of climate-smart agriculture as a viable strategy for the restoration and sustainable management of agricultural soils in arid and semiarid regions of Mexico.

Invasive alien plants in riparian ecosystems: a study from two lowland rivers in Eastern Poland
abstractText: Abstract Riparian ecosystems are biodiversity hotspots but are also highly vulnerable to biological invasions due to strong hydrological connectivity, recurrent disturbance and exposure to nutrient inputs. This study examined patterns of invasive alien plant species (IAS) occurrence along two lowland rivers in eastern Poland (the Biala Lada and Czarna Lada). Vegetation was surveyed at ten sites representing different land-use contexts using 150 phytosociological plots. Floristic diversity metrics, Ellenberg indicator values (EIVs), and a vegetation-based Index of Biotic Integrity (IBI) were used to characterise vegetation composition and ecological conditions. Logistic regression based on species-level Ellenberg indicator classes showed that invasive species differed significantly from non-invasive taxa in their ecological preferences. Species belonging to higher nitrogen and temperature indicator classes were more likely to be classified as invasive, indicating a stronger representation of eutrophic and thermophilous taxa within the invasive species pool. In contrast, soil reaction showed only a marginal relationship with invasion status. Sites with greater IAS occurrence were characterised by reduced evenness, increased dominance of ruderal taxa and stronger floristic homogenisation. The vegetation-based Index of Biotic Integrity (IBI) reflected variation in ecological quality across the studied riparian sites. The results suggest that invasive species in the studied river valleys are associated with distinct ecological preference profiles, particularly with respect to nutrient availability and temperature requirements. Field-based Ellenberg indicators and the vegetation-based Index of Biotic Integrity (IBI) describe variation in habitat conditions among the studied sites, while the species-level Ellenberg classes describe the ecological attributes of the local invasive versus non-invasive species pool; together these indicators provide complementary tools for characterising riparian vegetation and invasion-related patterns.

title: Carbon Content and Economic Value of “Lamtoro” Biomass for the Co-Firing Control Plant on Timor Island, Indonesia
abstractText: Timor Island has a good source of lamtoro (Leucaena leucocephala) energy forests. Although lamtoro has been used for the substitution of coal within the co-firing control plant on Timor Island, there is no empirical data on the carbon content, calorific, and economic values generated from the biomass. This study aims to investigate the potential for lamtoro woodlands to produce renewable biomass. The proximate, ultimate, and chlorine techniques have been used to analyze carbon content and calorific values. While the economic value added (EVA) tools of analysis have been used to analyze the economic value of biomass. The result of the study shows that the calorific value (HHV—higher heating value) of the coal and biomass blend with a proportion of 95%:5% is 4,342 kcal kg⁻¹, almost equivalent to the highest calorific value of coal. The commercialization of biomass created from lamtoro is financially viable, as evidenced by the company's financial performance. Analysis of the financial performance included in the biomass generation commerce showed that each kilogram of lamtoro biomass contributes IDR133.23 (18%) to the final product's value, indicating positive business prospects. Based on this result, the government should implement a policy to develop and maintain the existing forest as a source of bioenergy.

Self-organized ventilation defects in asthma: insights and open-source implementation of the Venegas–Winkler model
abstractText: Abstract The Venegas–Winkler model is a seminal model in asthma pathophysiology, providing both a conceptual and quantitative framework for extending a posited bistability between open and closed states at the level of the individual, terminal airway to the lung as a whole. In doing so, it offers an explanation for the characteristic ventilation heterogeneity (or clustered ventilation defects) seen in asthma. The terminal airway bistability is based on the Anafi–Wilson model, and this is embedded and extended into a symmetric bifurcating airway tree, in which an enforced tidal volume target and an imposed degree of airway smooth-muscle activation interact to generate spatially structured ventilation patterns. Here, we provide the first open-source implementation of the Venegas–Winkler bronchoconstriction cascade model and use it to identify several previously undescribed properties: both the tree depth and wall thickness assumptions affect the bifurcation onset, tidal volume and acinar elastance assumptions require careful interpretation for a model at sub-lung scale and airway geometry assumptions strongly affect driving pressures and bifurcation cascade characteristics.

Lifelong health leadership: reframing geriatrics as a model of care for resilient health systems
abstractText: Abstract Population ageing is commonly framed as a demographic challenge, biological frontier, or economic pressure. Yet these perspectives remain incomplete unless longevity is also understood as a leadership challenge. Gains in lifespan have not been matched by equivalent gains in healthspan, widening the period lived with multimorbidity, frailty, disability, cognitive vulnerability, loneliness, and dependency. Recent global analyses estimate a mean healthspan–lifespan gap of 9.6 years across 183 World Health Organization member states, while the population aged 60 years and older is projected to reach 1.4 billion by 2030 and 2.1 billion by 2050. This perspective aims to redefine the contribution of geriatrics across the life course and to propose a framework in which geriatricians act as lifelong health advocates within resilient, collaborative, and function-oriented health systems. This view argues that the longevity era requires geriatric care to evolve beyond the reactive management of late-life complexity toward anticipatory leadership of biological, functional, social, and organizational trajectories. Such transformation cannot be entrusted to geriatricians alone. It requires shared leadership across professions, organizations, communities, and policy systems. Geriatricians can contribute as physicians of trajectories, working with nurses, allied health professionals, managers, policymakers, patients, and communities to develop adaptive systems that preserve intrinsic capacity, functional ability, autonomy, and resilience before dependency becomes established. Drawing on healthy ageing, intrinsic capacity, integrated care, and health-system resilience, we propose “Lifelong Health Leadership” as a framework aligning clinical practice, organizational governance, workforce sustainability, intergenerational collaboration, and public health strategy. Rather than replacing traditional geriatrics, this framework expands its mandate and positions the discipline as a central contributor to health systems that anticipate vulnerability, preserve function, and support healthy longevity across the life course.

title: Ontogeny of settlement behaviours in response to Grammatophora marina diatom biofilms in the marine polychaete, Platynereis dumerilii
abstractText: Abstract Settlement, the transition of a swimming planktonic larva to a benthic juvenile, is a key process during the development of many marine invertebrates. Microbial biofilms act as positive cues for larval settlement across species, yet the behavioural processes preceding settlement are poorly understood. Here, we investigated age-dependent changes in settlement behaviour in marine polychaete Platynereis dumerilii larvae in response to Grammatophora marina diatom biofilms. Settlement behaviours (crawling, crawling speed and track straightness) were quantified from recordings of larvae ranging from the mid-trochophore to late-nectochaete in the presence or absence of diatom biofilms, using spot-tracking software. As larvae developed, the proportion of individuals crawling over the biofilm increased. Older larvae colonized biofilms more rapidly and showed greater discrimination between G. marina biofilms and controls. Older larvae straighten their movements compared with individuals swimming in the presence of biofilms, or behaviour witnessed in the absence of biofilms. The prevalence of these behaviours may reflect changes in the prioritization of sensory inputs from physical and chemical cues as larvae develop. Our findings suggest that settlement behaviours are developmentally programmed in P. dumerilii. Understanding settlement behaviours in P. dumerilii expands on this species’ behavioural repertoire and sheds light on the evolutionary relationship between marine larvae and microalgal biofilms.

title: Wind conditions shape co-migration fidelity in trans-Saharan birds at a Mediterranean stopover site
abstractText: Abstract Weather is a key driver of bird migration, particularly near ecological barriers, where migratory species often converge before crossing. While its effects on individual timing are well documented, how weather reshapes the temporal assemblage of migratory bird communities remains unexplored. Using 18 years of standardised ringing data from 24 trans-Saharan species during pre-breeding migration, this study investigated whether weather conditions along the Mediterranean Sea influence annual network modularity, that is, the yearly interspecific clusters of co-occurrence at a stopover site, and measured the ‘co-migration fidelity’, defined as the tendency of species to co-occur in the same cluster over the years. Specifically, we examined the ‘modularity’ associations with tailwinds, temperature, and the North Atlantic Oscillation (NAO) index. Modularity increased significantly over time, revealing non-random species clusters whose arrival timing aligns under unfavourable winds. This suggests that less supportive winds may lead distinct species to migrate within the same narrow temporal window of favourable conditions, heightening co-migration fidelity. Conversely, modularity decreased sharply in years with stronger tailwinds, while temperature and NAO showed negligible effects. These findings provide novel evidence that shared environmental constraints during the sea crossing can shape the formation of migratory communities by prompting species' temporal convergence at a stopover.

title: Kemandirian Finansial Perspektif Mahasiswa
abstractText: This study is motivated by the phenomenon that many students continue to experience difficulties in managing their personal finances amid lifestyle pressures and influences from their social environment. These conditions provide the background for exploring how students understand financial independence in relation to their financial management practices. The objective of this research is to explore and understand the meaning of financial independence from the students’ perspective. This study employs a qualitative method with a phenomenological approach, using in-depth interviews with selected informants to examine their experiences and interpretations. The findings indicate that students have begun to develop awareness of personal financial management through preparing budgets, prioritizing needs over wants, and controlling consumptive behavior. However, the level of discipline in implementing these practices varies among students. Financial independence is interpreted as a form of responsibility and self-control, together with the ability to make independent and rational financial decisions. These findings illustrate that students’ understanding of financial independence encompasses both their financial management practices and the responsibility involved in making decisions about their personal finances.

title: Population Dynamics of (Asplenium nidus) as a Bed Bioindicator (Paradisaea minor jobiensis Rothschild, 1897) in the Period 2018-2024 in Barawai, Yapen Island, Papua, Indonesia
abstractText: Asplenium nidus is an epiphytic fern recognized as an ecological bioindicator associated with the nesting habitat of the lesser bird-of-paradise (Paradisaea minor jobiensis Rothschild, 1897). This study analyzed population dynamics of A. nidus between 2018 and 2024 and examined its relationship with host tree species as an indicator of forest ecosystem health in the Imbowiari Barawai Forest, Yapen Island, Papua, Indonesia. Field observations were conducted using a transect-plot method, and data were analyzed using diversity indices, descriptive statistics, and morphometric comparisons. In 2018, 63 individuals of A. nidus were recorded on 49 host tree species, with high host diversity (H′ = 3.77). In 2024, 79 individuals were recorded on only nine host species, resulting in moderate diversity (H′ = 1.79). Five host species, Canarium hirsutum, Pimeleodendron amboinicum, Intsia bijuga, Ficus sp., and Myristica longipes, consistently supported A. nidus populations in both periods. Morphometric characteristics showed no significant differences among sampling sites. These findings indicate that A. nidus can serve as a useful bioindicator of habitat conditions and provide baseline information for long-term ecological monitoring, habitat assessment, and conservation of bird-of-paradise nesting habitats in Papua and support sustainable forest management practices.

STRATEGI DIRECT INSTRUCTION PADA PEMBELAJARAN IPAS BAGI PESERTA DIDIK HAMBATAN INTELEKTUAL RINGAN
abstractText: Natural and Social Sciences (IPAS) learning for students with mild intellectual disabilities requires structured, concrete instruction suited to individual needs. This study described the implementation of Direct Instruction in IPAS learning for Phase B students with mild intellectual disabilities at SLB BC Murni Bandung, focusing on planning, implementation, evaluation, and supporting and inhibiting factors. A qualitative approach was employed. Participants were one classroom teacher and two students, identified as MR and RR. Data were collected through observation, semi-structured interviews, and documentation, then analyzed through data condensation, data display, and conclusion drawing and verification. Credibility was established through technique and source triangulation. Findings showed that the teacher prepared teaching modules, learning objectives, media, worksheets, and assessment instruments according to students’ characteristics. Instruction followed orientation, presentation, structured practice, guided practice, and independent practice, supported by picture cards, a talking animal book, and an Interactive Digital Board. MR’s ability to recognize animal names increased from three to six, while RR’s increased from four to seven. Supporting factors included teacher competence, concrete media, class size, and school support. The main constraints were limited attention, weak memory, and differences in learning ability. These findings indicate that Direct Instruction supports systematic, adaptive, and meaningful IPAS learning. ABSTRAK Pembelajaran IPAS bagi peserta didik dengan hambatan intelektual ringan memerlukan strategi yang terstruktur, konkret, dan sesuai dengan kebutuhan individual. Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan penerapan strategi Direct Instruction pada pembelajaran IPAS bagi peserta didik hambatan intelektual ringan Fase B di SLB BC Murni Kota Bandung, meliputi perencanaan, pelaksanaan, evaluasi, serta faktor pendukung dan penghambat. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif. Partisipan terdiri atas satu guru kelas dan dua peserta didik berinisial MR dan RR. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara semi-terstruktur, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis melalui kondensasi data, penyajian data, serta penarikan dan verifikasi kesimpulan. Kredibilitas data diperiksa melalui triangulasi teknik dan sumber. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa guru menyusun modul ajar, tujuan pembelajaran, media, LKPD, dan instrumen asesmen sesuai karakteristik peserta didik. Pembelajaran dilaksanakan melalui tahap orientasi, presentasi, latihan terstruktur, latihan terbimbing, dan latihan mandiri dengan dukungan kartu gambar, buku hewan bersuara, dan Papan Interaktif Digital. Kemampuan MR mengenali nama hewan meningkat dari tiga menjadi enam, sedangkan RR meningkat dari empat menjadi tujuh. Faktor pendukung meliputi kompetensi guru, media konkret, jumlah peserta didik yang sedikit, dan dukungan sekolah. Hambatan utama mencakup keterbatasan konsentrasi, daya ingat, dan perbedaan kemampuan belajar. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa Direct Instruction mendukung pembelajaran IPAS yang sistematis, adaptif, dan bermakna.

title: An Arabic Language Learning Curriculum Development Model Based on Pikir And Zikir at the Islamic University of Aceh
abstractText: This study aims to develop an Arabic language curriculum model based on pikir and zikir at Universitas Islam Aceh. The study uses a Research and Development (R&D) approach employing the Plomp educational design research model, operationalized through preliminary research, design, realization, testing, and evaluation, and revision. The preliminary stage involved seven Arabic language lecturers and curriculum administrators selected purposively, while the limited trial involved 50 undergraduate students, comprising 25 students in an experimental class and 25 students in a control class. Qualitative evidence was obtained through interviews, curriculum-document analysis, and classroom observation; quantitative evidence was obtained through Arabic proficiency tests. Qualitative data were analyzed through coding, categorization, thematic analysis, and interpretation, while quantitative data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, normality and homogeneity tests, an independent-samples t-test, and Cohen's d. The pilot results showed a higher post-test mean in the experimental class (84.16) than in the control class (75.08), with t(48)=3.91, p<.001, and Cohen's d=1.10. The exploratory findings identified four development needs: integration of competencies, strengthening of thinking skills, internalization of spiritual values, and integrative assessment. The resulting PZ-ARABIC Curriculum Model contains six components: philosophical foundations, learning outcomes, content structure, instructional strategies, learning experiences, and integrative assessment. The contribution of the model is to position pikir and zikir as organizing principles of curriculum development rather than as additional values attached only to learning materials. The novelty of the model lies in positioning pikir and zikir as organizing principles of the curriculum rather than merely additional values embedded in instructional materials. The model provides an alternative framework for developing Arabic curricula that are integrative, communicative, critical, reflective, and spiritually oriented.
